import anndata as ad
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import MaxAbsScaler

train = ad.read_h5ad('/workspace/public_assets/train.h5ad')
dev_ctrl = ad.read_h5ad('/workspace/public_assets/dev_controls.h5ad')
dev_tgt = ad.read_h5ad('/workspace/public_assets/dev_targets.h5ad')

train_X = train.X.toarray() if hasattr(train.X, 'toarray') else np.asarray(train.X)
dev_ctrl_X = dev_ctrl.X.toarray() if hasattr(dev_ctrl.X, 'toarray') else np.asarray(dev_ctrl.X)
dev_tgt_X = dev_tgt.X.toarray() if hasattr(dev_tgt.X, 'toarray') else np.asarray(dev_tgt.X)

scaler = MaxAbsScaler()
scaler.fit(train_X)
train_scaled = scaler.transform(train_X)
dev_ctrl_scaled = scaler.transform(dev_ctrl_X)
dev_tgt_mean = dev_tgt_X.mean(axis=0)

cell_types = sorted(train.obs['cell_type'].unique())
ctrl_means = {}
stim_means = {}
for ct in cell_types:
    mask = train.obs['cell_type'] == ct
    ctrl = train_scaled[(mask.values) & (train.obs['condition'] == 'control').values]
    stim = train_scaled[(mask.values) & (train.obs['condition'] == 'stimulated').values]
    ctrl_means[ct] = ctrl.mean(axis=0)
    stim_means[ct] = stim.mean(axis=0)

ctrl_mat = np.stack([ctrl_means[ct] for ct in cell_types])
stim_mat = np.stack([stim_means[ct] for ct in cell_types])
diff_mat = stim_mat - ctrl_mat
n_ct = len(cell_types)

def loo_orig(up_pow, dn_pow):
    mses = []
    for h in range(n_ct):
        rem = [i for i in range(n_ct) if i "'!= h]
        ho = ctrl_mat[h]
        corrs = [np.corrcoef(ho, ctrl_mat[r])[0,1] if np.isfinite(np.corrcoef(ho, ctrl_mat[r])[0,1]) else -1 for r in rem]
        nidx = rem[int(np.argmax(corrs))]
        r = np.clip(np.where(ctrl_mat[nidx] > 1e-8, ho / np.maximum(ctrl_mat[nidx], 1e-8), 1.0), 0.1, 10.0)
        nd = diff_mat[nidx]
        um = nd > 0
        dm = nd < 0
        sd = np.zeros_like(nd)
        sd[um] = nd[um] * (r[um] ** up_pow)
        sd[dm] = nd[dm] * (r[dm] ** dn_pow)
        pred = np.clip(ho + sd, 0, 1)
        po = scaler.inverse_transform(pred.reshape(1,-1)).flatten()
        so = scaler.inverse_transform(stim_mat[h].reshape(1,-1)).flatten()
        mses.append(np.mean((so - po)**2))
    return np.mean(mses)

# Quick scan: uniform best
best_u = 1e9
bu = 0
for p in [0.18, 0.20, 0.22, 0.24, 0.26, 0.28, 0.30]:
    m = loo_orig(p, p)
    if m < best_u:
        best_u = m
        bu = p
    print(f'"'uniform pow={p:.2f}: {m:.8f}')

print(f'Best uniform: {bu:.2f}, MSE={best_u:.8f}')

# Sign-aware: scan coarse grid
print()
best_s = 1e9
bsu = bsd = 0
for up in [0.0, 0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.25, 0.30, 0.40, 0.50]:
    for dn in [0.0, 0.10, 0.20, 0.30, 0.40, 0.50, 0.60, 0.70, 0.80, 1.00]:
        m = loo_orig(up, dn)
        if m < best_s:
            best_s = m
            bsu = up
            bsd = dn
print(f'Best sign-aware (coarse): up={bsu:.2f}, dn={bsd:.2f}, MSE={best_s:.8f}')
print(f'Improvement: {(best_u-best_s)/best_u*100:.2f}%')

# Dev check
dev_mean = dev_ctrl_scaled.mean(axis=0)
corrs = [np.corrcoef(dev_mean, ctrl_mat[i])[0,1] if np.isfinite(np.corrcoef(dev_mean, ctrl_mat[i])[0,1]) else -1 for i in range(n_ct)]
nidx = int(np.argmax(corrs))
print(f'\\nDev nearest: {cell_types[nidx]} (corr={max(corrs):.4f})')
nd = diff_mat[nidx]
r_dev = np.clip(np.where(ctrl_mat[nidx] > 1e-8, dev_mean / np.maximum(ctrl_mat[nidx], 1e-8), 1.0), 0.1, 10.0)

# Uniform best
pred_u = np.clip(dev_mean + nd * (r_dev ** bu), 0, 1)
pred_u_o = scaler.inverse_transform(pred_u.reshape(1,-1)).flatten()
mse_u = np.mean((dev_tgt_mean - np.clip(pred_u_o, 0, None))**2)
print(f'Dev uniform (pow={bu:.2f}): {mse_u:.8f}')

# Sign-aware best
um = nd > 0
dm = nd < 0
sd = np.zeros_like(nd)
sd[um] = nd[um] * (r_dev[um] ** bsu)
sd[dm] = nd[dm] * (r_dev[dm] ** bsd)
pred_s = np.clip(dev_mean + sd, 0, 1)
pred_s_o = scaler.inverse_transform(pred_s.reshape(1,-1)).flatten()
mse_s = np.mean((dev_tgt_mean - np.clip(pred_s_o, 0, None))**2)
print(f'Dev sign-aware (up={bsu:.2f}, dn={bsd:.2f}): {mse_s:.8f}')
print(f'Dev improvement: {(mse_u-mse_s)/mse_u*100:.2f}%')
